stances.quote: I came to Congress to protect and defend our national security, and I recognize that safeguarding our national security requires a strong national defense. As the United States faces unprecedented threats from our adversaries, such as China, Russia, and Iran, we must continue to ensure that our warfighters are equipped with the best available tools and resources.
stances.reasoning: Text explicitly calls for a strong national defense with best tools and resources for warfighters amid threats.
No statements on taxation appear in the text.

stances.quote: I believe that we must reduce wasteful spending, eliminate fraud, and streamline government operations so that innovation can thrive. I am proudly pro-growth, pro-family, and pro-worker. It’s time to put money back in the pockets of American families and workers and right-size wasteful government spending.
stances.reasoning: Text explicitly advocates reducing wasteful spending and right-sizing government spending.
No statements on trade policy or tariffs appear in the text.
No statements on foreign aid appear in the text.
